response.answer: Your record supports stating that you can sustain full retouching-bench work with hourly posture resets, and can undertake brief overhead tasks (for example, short ladder work or about an hour of mount adjustments). It does not support sustained or unbroken overhead/scaffold shifts: your physiotherapist specifically linked neck-flare risk to sustained overhead positions, and a three-day run of long overhead scaffold shifts caused severe neck locking. For install season, request duties structured to avoid prolonged overhead work, with regular posture breaks and reassignment of extended overhead tasks where possible.
